sources.note: Main landing page. Describes CareCloud as publicly traded (CCLD), cloud-based + AI-powered healthcare platform with EHR, RCM, PM, Breeze (patient experience), telehealth. Over 40,000 providers. Highlights cirrusAI and stratusAI features.

ONC certification disclosures page for CareCloud Charts. Lists product as ONC-ACB certified, includes Real World Test Plans/Results 2022-2025. Describes integrated EHR, RCM, PM, patient experience, telehealth capabilities.

EHR features page. Details flexible charting, configurable templates, integrated order sets, cirrusAI Notes, clinical decision support, unified inbox, advanced reporting, population health, quality tracking, mobile access.

Product tour listing 9 main components: Appointments, Patients, EHR (Charts), Billing, Collections, Patient Experience (Breeze), Analytics, KPI Dashboard, MIPS Dashboard. Shows integrated clinical-administrative-financial platform.

CareCloud Central (PM) page. Smart scheduling, automated reminders, eligibility verification, billing with CollectiveIQ rules engine, claims management, denial management, automated nightly claims submission.

CareCloud Breeze patient experience platform. Online scheduling, automated reminders, digital intake forms, two-way messaging, telehealth integration, online payments (credit card, e-check, payment plans), QR code check-in.

Nephrology specialty page. CKD tracking, dialysis management, automated charting with predefined nephrology templates, integrated billing rules for nephrology. Confirms specialty-specific template support.
Business.com review, 8.9/10 rating. Highlights workflow-focused design, drag-and-drop scheduling, patient engagement via Breeze. Content was partially truncated.

FindEMR review with user sentiment breakdown. 60% positive on interface/workflows, 50% positive on billing. Criticism on slow loading, support delays, high costs ($628/provider/month for EMR+PM). Mentions telehealth (CareCloud Live).

Medesk review. Key finding: CareCloud operates multiple EHR products — Charts, talkEHR, and VertexDR (anesthesiology). Pricing: PMS $349/mo, EMR+PM $628/mo, Breeze add-on $199/mo. 3-year contracts typical.

March 2021 press release: MTBC rebrands to CareCloud, Inc. Details the company history, 2020 acquisitions of CareCloud Corporation and Meridian Medical Management, 40,000+ providers, 3,000+ employees at time of rebrand.

Company history overview. Founded 1999 as MTBC, IPO 2014, 16+ acquisitions including Gulf Coast Billing, Renaissance Physician Services, MediGain, Orion. Acquired CareCloud Corp ($36M) and Meridian ($24.8M) in 2020.
